description: Issue #3's motivating input as the issue writes it, with no <tool_call> wrapper: <function=f></parameters></parameters></function>. The stripped wrapper tokens are read as inserted (tool_call.markup.missing-token, markup repairs) and the closers-only body is f {} with its markup loss recorded, so on a Mutating tool under Structural with no required parameter the call is Resolved, under every built-in dialect.
